rationale: Iteration 0 has no race telemetry or evaluator feedback yet, so this is a conservative baseline built from the contract. Geometry: five sensors spaced 0.02 m apart across x = -0.04 to +0.04 m, placed 0.04 m ahead of the axle. That spacing covers the 25 mm tape with overlap, and the forward offset lets the sensors see the line before the wheels reach it. Sensor size is 0.012 m, matching the tape-to-sensor ratio. Wheel track 0.12 m and wheel radius 0.03 m give a moderate turn rate. Body width 0.16 m raises the off-track limit to about 0.0525 m, giving margin on sharp bends. Mass 0.8 kg and body length 0.16 m are mid-range. Controller: base_speed 1.8 (about 90% of full PWM) to target the roughly 1.5 m/s average needed to finish in 3 s. Weights [-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1] give a signal within [-1, 1]. kp 4 gives a full-scale turn of about 1400 PWM counts, which is firm but not saturating. ki 0.05 is small to avoid integral windup on bends. kd 0.3 damps oscillation. line_loss 'last_direction' lets the robot recover toward the side it was last on. Expected result: completion on the oval and s-bend, with some wobble on the slalom. The measurements requested below will show whether kp or base_speed is the limit.
